title: Potato Chips, Sour Cream and Onion Flavored

content.title: About
content.content: Potato chips, sour cream and onion flavored are thinly sliced potatoes fried to a crisp and seasoned with a blend of dry sour cream and onion powders. They deliver a creamy, slightly tangy taste with a gentle onion bite and the classic snack aroma.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sour cream & onion flavor is one of the most popular snack varieties in North America and Europe.
Manufacturers use powdered dairy and onion to achieve the flavor while keeping shelf life long.
These chips are commonly served as a bar snack alongside beer and other beverages.
Thin slicing ensures an even, crunchy texture.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Potatoes provide carbohydrates that quickly supply the body with energy.

items.title: Vitamin C content
items.content: Despite frying, a small amount of vitamin C, an antioxidant that supports immunity, remains.

items.title: Potassium
items.content: Potatoes are rich in potassium, important for fluid balance and muscle function.

items.title: High sodium
items.content: Chips often contain a notable amount of salt, which may be problematic for hypertension.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Because they are fried, chips are calorie‑dense; moderate consumption is advised.

items.title: Trans fats
items.content: Some brands use oils that contain trans fats; choose products labeled trans‑fat free.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy chips straight from the bag, pair them with dips such as ranch, guacamole, or cheese sauce, or sprinkle them over salads for added crunch.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep chips in a sealed package in a cool, dry place away from light. Once opened, consume within a few weeks to maintain crispness.
